column1: # p477 address sweep, 2026-10-27. Gap 476-E: measure how many addresses in RETAINED HISTORY are stale.
# Population: every github.com/<owner>/<repo> token on the eight live shelves (3,217 distinct after cleaning
# GitHub URL paths such as search/, topics/, trending/ out of the extraction).
# Sampling: tier A = all 193 addresses republished >=10 times (load-bearing); tier B = 80 drawn with
# `shuf --random-source=<(yes p477)` from those republished <10 times (the long tail), so the draw is reproducible.
# git_resolve  : `git ls-remote --symref https://github.com/<repo> HEAD`, exit status. Free channel, run on all.
# index_present: authenticated search, `repo:` qualifier, batched. Run on the first 110 only (see Gap 477-B).
# NOTE the fork control: GitHub repo search EXCLUDES forks by default, so index_absent does NOT imply stale.
#      Every index_absent row below was re-queried with `fork:true` before a verdict was given.
